name: courier
description: A verified ID and spending limits for AI agents, powered by PayPal.

scripts.live-recording: PAYPAL_LIVE=real-money COURIER_URL=http://localhost:4000 STORE_URL=http://localhost:4100 DATA_DIR=data/live node --env-file=.env.live scripts/dev.mjs
scripts.demo: PAYPAL_MODE=simulated COURIER_URL=http://localhost:4000 STORE_URL=http://localhost:4100 DATA_DIR=data/demo node scripts/dev.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.sdk: npm run sdk:typescript && npm run sdk:python
scripts.sdk:typescript: npx -y @apimatic/cli@2.2.0 sdk generate -i sdk -l typescript -d sdk/typescript -f
scripts.sdk:python: npx -y @apimatic/cli@2.2.0 sdk generate -i sdk -l python -d sdk/python -f
